title: (ChatGPT- Progress Update) Pizza Tower and Sonic Mania Combined Mod
author: Sweaty-Campaign-1609
selftext:
Well, here's another update on my little experiment combining Pizza Tower's gameplay with Sonic Mania using ChatGPT!

After a lot of testing, adjustments, and troubleshooting, I've finally reached a point where the mod is actually functional!

There are still some issues here and there, like certain floors losing collision or sections of levels that can't be completed properly because they rely on Sonic-specific mechanics.

Still, I think this is probably as far as I can take this experiment for now. From this point onward, getting everything to work properly would likely require some actual hands-on programming and manual adjustments rather than relying entirely on AI.

Even with those limitations, I'm pretty happy with how far this little experiment has come, especially considering how it started!

Just wanted to share the progress with you all!
